post.summary: Generate tokens to access other KLARA core endpoints
post.description:
After obtaining tenant id and company id for the desired tenant, use this endpoint to get the access token for a specific tenant, and refresh token.
A grant_type of password is used for a Password grant, which requires username, password, tenant and company id to produce access token, refresh token from scratch.
A grant_type of refresh_token is used for a Refresh token grant, which is used for acquiring the access token using refresh token.
A grant_type of token_exchange performs an OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (RFC 8693). Provide subject_token (the raw upstream Bearer token, without the 'Bearer ' prefix) and audience to identify the target token type.
Supported audience values:
  • cossa — exchanges a COSSA bearer token for a ePost access token.
Note: subject_token must be the raw token value without the 'Bearer ' prefix.

post.summary: Submit a document for signing and create a signing process.
post.description: Submits exactly ONE document to be signed and creates a signing process. Uses multipart/form-data analogous to POST /epost/v2/deliveries: a file part (the PDF) and a metadata JSON part (SigningProcessCreateRequest). The document is stored, a slot per participant is created, and the signature document is made available to each participant in the signing room. Participants without an ePost account receive a forced-onboarding email when forceOnboarding = true AND the credential is an email address (onboarded users can complete only SES). Returns the created process id and its initial status; full details via GET /signing/processes/{processId}. Access requires the ePost Sign widget subscription. Billing a signing to a company requires the DOCUMENT_SIGN_BILLING company role in the KLARA web client role system on the paying company.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key that prevents duplicate process creation on retries. Optional: if omitted, retries may create a duplicate process. Same key + same payload returns the original result; same key + different payload → HTTP 409.

requestBody.description:
Multipart body with exactly two parts:
  • file — the PDF to be signed (application/pdf). Exactly ONE file per process. Size limit: 200 MB per document. Requests advertising a larger Content-Length are rejected with HTTP 413 (SIGNING_UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE) before the body is buffered; missing / malformed Content-Length is rejected with HTTP 411 (SIGNING_CONTENT_LENGTH_REQUIRED).
  • metadata — application/json body of type SigningProcessCreateRequest.

How to fill metadata:
  • title (required, ≤ 255) — shown in the list and the signing room.
  • description (optional, ≤ 2000).
  • signatureType (required) — one of SES, AES, QES. Locked after creation.
  • participants (required, ≥ 1) — must contain at least one ADMIN, at least one SIGNER, AND at least one RECEIVER (the signed document is delivered strictly to RECEIVER participants; a request without one is rejected with HTTP 422). See ParticipantInput.
  • mode (optional, default PARALLEL) — locked after creation.
  • deadline (required, ISO date).
  • documentHandling (optional) — allowPrint / allowSave both default to false.
  • forceOnboarding (required) — only effective when the participant credential is an email address.
  • billToCompanyTenantId (optional) — retrieve eligible values via GET /signing/billing-companies. Requires the DOCUMENT_SIGN_BILLING company role on the referenced company.

allOf.description:
Specifies the tier for the delivery via channel DIGITAL. This selection determines the availability of digital receipts, tracking capabilities, and recipient identification requirements. If digitalDeliveryVariant is omitted, the system defaults to 'STANDARD'.

STANDARD: Standard digital delivery with proof of dispatch. Includes a digital timestamp and signature upon acceptance by ePost. [ePost Standard]
NO_CONFIRMATION: Basic digital delivery. Provides a digital delivery without additional digital receipts or tracking features. [ePost Light]
TRACKED: Enhanced delivery with retrieval tracking. Includes all features of STANDARD, plus 'Retrieval' and 'Non-retrieval' receipts to track if and when the recipient opened the message. [ePost Plus]
REGISTERED: Full legal-grade digital registered mail. Includes all TRACKED features, as well as recipient acceptance/rejection tracking and mandatory Person Identification. Important note: 'minimumLevelOfTrust' must be set to GOLD for the recipient, as verification of the recipient as a person by an online identification process is prerequisite for ePost Registered. [ePost Registered]

deliveryChannelPreferences.description:
This value defines your preference & priority among delivery channels. It defines that your letter/message/document should be delivered via which one of the available channels. You can input more than one delivery channel.

The order of delivery channels defines the priority of each channel. Meaning, at first we try to deliver via the first mentioned delivery channel, if it's unsuccessful, we would try via the second channel mentioned, and so on.

If delivery is not successful via any of the delivery methods, then an error response will be returned to the sender.

DIGITAL delivering it to the recipient's ePost letterbox (available for all types of documents/letters/messages)
PHYSICAL printing and sending the letter physically (only specific pdf formats are accepted)
SMS delivering the "simple short message" as a SMS to the recipient's mobile phone. (only for simple short message media type)
EBILL delivering it to the recipient's eBill (available for invoice document type with pdf format)
EMAIL delivering it to the recipient who using email
AUTO will try to find most suitable one from all available channel in order like this (DIGITAL, SMS, EBILL, PHYSICAL, EMAIL) then do the delivering

ILetter.description: iLetter reference parameters supplied per file under digitalAdditionalInfo when the file is an iLetter document. Set mediaType to "application/vnd.ch.klara.epost.v1+iletter" and provide templateId to send an interactive iLetter created from that Template; such a document carries no file binary. On a document with any other mediaType this object has no effect: no iLetter is created or touched and the delivery is neither rejected nor altered.

templateId.description: Id of the iLetter Template used to create the iLetter to send. Required for every iLetter document sent through this API. Applies only to iLetter documents; ignored on other document types.

batchId.description: Optional correlation key grouping several deliveries onto one iLetter record: sending the same batchId again appends the new recipients to the existing iLetter instead of creating a new one. If omitted, this delivery always creates its own new iLetter, and a resend of a failed delivery updates that same iLetter rather than creating a second one.

confidentialResponses.description: Whether the iLetter collects confidential responses: answers are not shown to the sender together with who gave them. Defaults to not confidential when absent.

responseDeadline.description: Date and time by which recipients are asked to answer, as an ISO-8601 instant with UTC offset, for example 2026-10-31T21:59:59Z. Passed on exactly as supplied. Absent means no deadline.

parameters.description: Default values for this document's iLetter URL parameters, appended to the letter's data-source calls; one entry per key, at most 20 entries. A recipient may override individual keys under recipients[].iLetter.parameters; per key the recipient's value applies when supplied, otherwise this document-level value. A recipient left without a value for a required key fails with ILETTER_PARAMETER_REQUIRED_VALUE_MISSING naming the key; a key the Template does not declare fails with ILETTER_PARAMETER_KEY_UNKNOWN.

placeholders.description: Values for the letter's text placeholders, substituted into the letter text; one entry per key, applied to every recipient of this document. A recipient may override individual keys under recipients[].iLetter.placeholders; per key the recipient's value applies when supplied, otherwise this value. At most 100 entries per level, values of at most 2000 characters; a document over these limits is rejected with ILETTER_PLACEHOLDER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. A value for a key the letter does not define is ignored. Unlike a missing URL parameter, a recipient left without a value for a required placeholder does not reject the request: that recipient ends in a failed status with ILETTER_PLACEHOLDER_REQUIRED_VALUE_MISSING naming the key, and the other recipients are delivered.

key.description: Must match a SENDER_PARAMETER key declared on the iLetter's data sources. At most 64 characters; starts with a letter or underscore, followed by letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

value.description: The value substituted for this key when the recipient's iLetter resolves the data source. At most 128 characters.

key.description: Key of a placeholder defined on the letter. At most 64 characters; starts with a letter or underscore, followed by letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. A key the letter does not define is ignored.

value.description: Text shown to the recipient in place of the placeholder. Any characters, including line breaks; at most 2000 characters.

channel.description: The channel we will use to contact the recipient with the request to onboard to ePost. Currently, only EMAIL is supported.

forcedOnboarding.description:
This object is optional. Defines whether all recipients of this document should be forced to register to ePost in order to receive this document. If the recipient is already registered to ePost, the normal delivery flow applies. If the recipient is not yet registered to ePost, we will send him an email asking him to register to ePost in order to receive the document. The document is stored for up to 60 days and will be delivered to the recipient as soon as he registers to ePost. After 60 days the delivery will expire.
Reminder emails are sent to the recipient after 2, 25, 40 and 55 days.
Forced onboarding is only available for the delivery channel DIGITAL. Additionally the unhashed credential EMAIL is required for forced onboarding (onboarding request email will be sent to this email address) and the minimum level of trust must be BRONZE.
